description.purpose: A character in a shared world: a world adapter and a handset around a referenced `simple-agent`. The world's tools are client tools of each turn, the handset speaks to a colony the way a human channel does, and the role (`human-sim` or `npc`) sets the agent's frame. Since 1.0.1 (#1292) the template pins `simple-agent@1.0.1`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.2 (#1294) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.1`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.3 (#1298) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.2`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.4 (#1300) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.3`; it is the third digit.
description.use_when: One instance per character, in a world colony or a player's own colony alike.
description.not_in_scope: No model, memory or grant of its own (all the agent's), no world knowledge, no deadline of its own.
examples: obs -> turn -> call* -> intent; night -> close of every session of the day -> night
